channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: Carroll Less — Thorsby quarterback takes Advertiser offensive POTY honors
item.description: After leading Thorsby to a 9-2 season with 2,565 yards and 40 TDs, senior QB Braylon Carroll earns The Clanton Advertiser’s 2025 Offensive Player of the Year; full All-Advertiser team inside.

item.title: Column: Guarding Truth Without Losing Tenderness
item.description: April J. Buchanan urges Christians to defend Gospel truth while staying humble, prayerful and tender, letting Scripture first correct their own hearts.

item.title: Thorsby, Verbena receive donation towards art programs from WoodmenLife
item.description: WoodmenLife's Clanton-based Chapter 322 donated $2,000 to Thorsby and Verbena High School art programs to fund supplies for K-6 students.

item.title: Column: Look for the good, you will find it
item.description: A writer reflects on roommates, road trips and Piggly Wiggly parking lots to show how choosing to look for the good can reveal unexpected beauty in everyday life.

item.title: Column: Nature, art, community blend through botanical design
item.description: Florist and stylist Andrea Huff weaves heritage and community through PLANT, her botanical design practice, and an upcoming pressed flower ornament workshop at Central Alabama Arts Alliance.

item.title: Mr. Tacos — Made by hand, made with care
item.description: Mr. Tacos opens a new Jemison location with handmade murals, furniture and food, plus an expanded menu blending authentic Mexican dishes with new flavors.

item.title: CCSO receives AEDs, CPR machine through grant
item.description: Chilton County deputies now carry AEDs in all patrol vehicles after a grant from the Alabama Sheriffs Association boosted their life-saving tools.

item.title: If You Build It — Lots of firsts at Rebels' new softball park
item.description: After 38 years at a city park, Thorsby softball opened its own on-campus field, celebrating the debut with a 13-1 win over Billingsley and a standout day from pitcher Brooklyn Reeser.

item.title: Perfecto — Hallman tosses perfect game in season opener for CMS
item.description: Clanton Middle School’s Lane Hallman tosses a five-inning perfect game with 13 strikeouts in the season opener, leading CMS to a 4-0 win and doubleheader sweep of Marbury.

item.title: A New Age — CCS details projects at Verbena’s annex, high school campuses
item.description: Chilton County Schools will add a full-service kitchen, new classrooms and a new gym-anchored athletic complex to Verbena campuses, with work expected to finish by year’s end.
